title: piriqueta odorata
intro: Piriqueta odorata, commonly known as Manacá, is a plant species that belongs to the family Passifloraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Piriqueta odorata involve anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Piriqueta odorata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects and have been used in traditional medicine for centuries.
